# Motomation Design

> An agent skill by asfakulsiam for original, award-level websites that are minimal, modern and typography-led, with motion as the signature, up to "Motomation": scrolling that plays like a film. MIT licensed.

- [Skill entry point](skills/asfakulsiam-motomation-design/SKILL.md): router, five laws, default flow, tiers, commands
- [Thinking Sequence](skills/asfakulsiam-motomation-design/thinking/sequence.md): tension, concept, archetype + mutation, collision, signature, anti-sameness, restraint
- [Motomation (Tier 5)](skills/asfakulsiam-motomation-design/motion/tier-5-motomation.md): scroll-as-film method and code
- [Commands](skills/asfakulsiam-motomation-design/commands/overview.md)
- [Delivery Gate](skills/asfakulsiam-motomation-design/gates/delivery-gate.md)
- [Single-file edition](dist/motomation-design.md): for chat tools without a shell
- Install: `npx skills add asfakulsiam/asfakulsiam-motomation-design`
